given: the stock view rendering stock positions after the tracking code has been split
when: the operator views the stock positions
then: the old combined tracking code is no longer displayed anywhere in the stock view, so the batch and serial fields are the only surface for that identity

independence.rationale: AC1 and AC2 assert the new batch and serial fields render (populated and empty); AC3 asserts the retired combined code is absent. A view could add the new fields while still showing the old combined code alongside them, so this fails independently.
